deviations: Data read with haven::read_dta + zap_labels instead of readstata13::read.dta13; all labelled survey variables are fully labelled, so factor() on the numeric codes gives the same dummy sets as the authors' factors.
Help.R::bin.summary reimplemented as glm(binomial) on na.omit of the model variables plus the cluster id, with sandwich::vcovCL clustered by ags_county (same as the authors).
notes: attempt-1 was exploratory (variable types/labels, wave counts, context.dta structure; no RESULT lines). The final run is the first and only scored run: Table 1 columns 1-6 are lm() on wave-4 respondents following SurveyAnalysis_Main.R; SI Table C1 columns 5 (Sum, 2015 cross-section, state FE) and 6 (Annual, municipality-years, state + year FE) are logits following ContextAnalysis_Appendix.R, after trimming Excess Males to its 2.5-97.5 percentile range in 2015. I checked that municipality row order matches across years before summing hate crimes positionally as the authors do. After the run I compared the RESULT values with the claimed values by eye: all 13 match to the reported precision, so the script was not changed and no claim attempt was recorded.
